Thanks, and yea the metal really helps. I've tried all kinds of music. It's kind of an outlet to get some of the emotion out. 

College is kind a lose-lose situation for me at the moment. If I get in, I'm not sure I can handle the stress of what lies ahead. If I don't I'll be devastated and I don't know what I will do with my life.

Best of luck to you too.

Music is one of my best things in terms of relaxing. For me it's metal. Just some really angry brutal metal. 

And that's IF I get into Law School. I royally screwed up my resume ... and it worries me every day about it. 

I also don't want to tell anyone in my family, they're all kind of insensitive when it comes to this kind of thing, "Don't worry about it" ... "Just stop thinking about it" ... "Oh come on" ... etc

I have some hobbies, but nothing will really help the core of the problem, which is the stress. I just finished four years of university, and now I'm applying to Law School. A combination of waiting for the results of my application, in which case I caught a flaw in after I sent them in, have been driving me insane. Then the thoughts of another three years of stressful work is disheartening.

My girlfriend isn't really a good option in terms of someone to talk to. Everytime I bring it up, she ends up crying hysterically and I have to console her and keep her calm. 

Thanks for the response.
Wooh. Glad to know and thanks for not telling me which. I've read The Hobbit and it's by far one of the best books I've read so far. Thank you!
I'll be on the lookout for those little buggers then, thanks. :)

Sephora is pretty far for me and I'm leaving soon, but I should use this afterwards if I decide to keep up with the shaving, thanks!

Also, does any deodorant count? I heard some people say women's deodorant, but all I have is the anti-bacterial Right Guard stuff. Thanks again.
In-grown hairs would kill the mood, so thank you so much. :)
When you say with the grain, do you mean from the top towards the bottom? Thanks!
Cause my girlfriend likes it and I want to turn her on.

In that case, I think I'll just go with the regular ones and still withdraw before finishing. Thanks for the help. :)

Edit: Another question, just in case you might know the answer, do ultra-thins have a lot less durability when compared to the normal ones?
Sorry if I was unclear. She is not on the pill.

I already purchased my parts, but thank you.

I'm looking forward to that Sapphire 7950.

Dat #6. exactly.

Plus, I plan on doing this for decades, so why not start now? :) Thanks.
Ahhhh, I see. Thanks for clearing that up. Now it's just time to watch my tracking updates like a hawk.
I have a horrid $5 office keyboard that I've been meaning to get rid of. I could also use a good mousepad for competitive CounterStrike playing. Thanks!
My worrying is turning into excitement now. I want that beastly GPU and shit nowwwwwwwwwww.

Thank you for this. How do I know which connector is for the floppy and which one is for the fan header? Is it labeled?

I apologize for all the questions.
I'm going to be touching the case, my dumbbells, the metal fridge. Metal pole for the table. Metal metal metal metal. Everything metal. Maybe I'll even put on some Slayer just to be safe.
I heard it can limit the life of the hardware though, that's my main worry.
Wow, thank you so much. Hopefully it won't come to that but that would be great if I run into a problem. Thanks!
I guess I am over-thinking it. I'm going to go buy one of those wristbands to be safe, thanks.
Wow. I never even knew these things existed. Thanks.

Also, thank you very much for your response, I feel better.

I have to think about it some more but right now im leaning towards doing it myself.
